name: Mustafar Droid
description: The Mustafar Droid, also known as a crystal collecting archeological droid, was a type of probe droid utilized within the Vader's Castle battlefield in the Grand Arena on the planet Vespaara. They were designed for archeological purposes, equipped with a laser cutter and multiple clawed arms used to unearth and collect crystals that they could store in the collection pack on their backs.
